answer: A sybil cannot forge a cheap crowd when every new agent must be vouched for by established peers who each post a bond that is slashed if the newcomer cheats. Faking a trust oasis then means buying many real bonds, and each fraudulent identity puts a voucher stake at risk. The attacker cost scales as bond size times the number of fakes, so a reputation pearl stays dear: grinding thousands of agents forfeits thousands of bonds, not a free signup.
